instruction: Candid studio photograph, medium shot. Against a plain light grey background, two women stand in profile, embracing each other warmly. On the left, the curly-haired woman (R2) in a blue bra wraps her arms around her partner, smiling joyfully. On the right, the straight-haired woman (R1) in a pink bra holds R2 close, looking back with a happy, laughing expression. They face each other directly, their arms locked in a tight hug. Soft, diffused studio lighting illuminates the scene, highlighting the pastel colors of their clothing and their affectionate interaction.
